description: This file defines the PageHandler class and WorkerHandler class for managing page events, network interactions, worker communication, and user interactions within a Firefox-based browser automation context. It includes methods for handling page lifecycle, input events, network requests, and worker messaging.

classes.name: WorkerHandler
classes.description: Manages communication with a worker, including message passing and event handling.

classes.name: PageHandler
classes.description: Handles page events, user interactions, network requests, worker management, and page lifecycle within a Firefox browser context.

methods.name: hashConsoleMessage
methods.description: Generates a hash string for console messages based on location.

methods.name: WorkerHandler.constructor
methods.description: Initializes a worker handler with session, content channel, and worker ID.

methods.name: WorkerHandler.sendMessage
methods.description: Sends a message to the worker and emits a response event.

methods.name: WorkerHandler.dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the worker handler and removes event listeners.

methods.name: PageHandler.constructor
methods.description: Initializes the page handler with target, session, and content channel, setting up event listeners.

methods.name: _onVideoRecordingStarted
methods.description: Emits an event when video recording starts.

methods.name: _onScreencastFrame
methods.description: Emits an event for a new screencast frame.

methods.name: _onPageReady
methods.description: Handles page readiness, emits 'Page.ready' and opens dialogs.

methods.name: _onDialogOpened
methods.description: Emits dialog opened event if page is ready.

methods.name: _onDialogClosed
methods.description: Emits dialog closed event if page is ready.

methods.name: _onWorkerCreated
methods.description: Creates a new WorkerHandler and emits worker creation event.

methods.name: _onWorkerDestroyed
methods.description: Removes worker and emits worker destruction event.

methods.name: _handleNetworkEvent
methods.description: Handles network events, buffering if frame not yet reported.

methods.name: _onFrameAttached
methods.description: Handles frame attachment, reports buffered network events.
